text:
amanda: Heads up  Baycrest Systems invoice INV-2026-0622 is blocked by the payments engine. Vendor reissued and included a different PO + bank account in the same packet.

chris: Paste the PO on the PDF? Ill try an auto-match.

amanda: Invoice shows PO=BAY-2024-412; our PO master lists BAY-2026-251 as the active PO after the legal consolidation.

priya: Sorry  vendor merged two subsidiaries and AP accidentally used legacy PO on reissue. Correct PO should be BAY-2026-251. They also changed receiving bank to a new payments entity (effective 2026-03-26).

```
Old acct: BAY-STD-990
New acct: BAY-PAY-443 (effective 03/26)
```

dev: Any bank change triggers vendor verification. Procurement wont be able to sign off until Im back in 24h.

approvals-bot: Hold applied: reasons=[PO_MISMATCH, UNVERIFIED_BANK]; required_actions=[attach_signed_po_amendment, vendor_kba, procurement_confirmation_or_2up_finance].

chris: Two options: wait for procurement or do a temporary finance 2-up approval to avoid late penalties. Is this recurring spend?

amanda: It's a month-end infra invoice (model training instances). Risk of late fees in 5 days. Procurement backlog likely >72h. I recommend temporary finance signoff if Vendor provides amendment + KBA.

priya: Uploading signed amendment and vendor bank ownership doc now. Link: https://files.baycrest.example/INV-2026-0622-amend.pdf

dev: Amendment must reference both PO numbers and vendor tax ID. If it does, procurement will reconcile on return.

priya: Amendment includes TAXID and both PO numbers plus AP contact. Bank doc includes proof of account ownership.

chris: Amanda, can you post GL and cost center so I can request treasury manual override? Need two approvers for risk.

amanda: GL=5402-compute; cost_center=platform-infra-prod. Posting audit note: "Temporary finance approval pending procurement reconciliation; docs attached."

chris: Submitted manual override to Treasury with reference "Baycrest merged entity; temporary 2-up finance approval; amendment attached." ETA 24-48h. Flagged urgent.

approvals-bot: Documents attached. Pending actions updated: [treasury_manual_override, procurement_reconcile_ticket].

dev: Ill create the procurement ticket now and set priority to high. Will reconcile PO mapping when back.

priya: Vendor requests payment confirmation once issued. Theyre sensitive about cashflow.

amanda: Noted. Ill monitor treasury response and update thread. If treasury rejects, we escalate to Finance Lead for emergency signoff.

chris: Closing summary: amendment + KBA attached; GL set; manual override requested; approvals-bot hold remains until procurement reconciles or treasury clears payment.

priya: Thanks everyone :pray:
_meta: Slack thread export: vendor merged entity caused PO mismatch and bank update; includes root message and replies in chronological order
